div.span: Software Quality Assurance Engineer I at FICO • Bangalore, India

h1.class: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight mb-6 leading-tight

div.h1:
Driving Elite Quality Through
Automation & AI-Enabled Testing.

p.class: text-base md:text-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-8 font-normal leading-relaxed max-w-3xl

div.p: Software Quality Assurance Engineer with over 3 years of experience in Test Automation, Playwright, Robot Framework, REST API Testing, CI/CD, and Python. Recognized with multiple Impact, SPOT, and STOM awards for driving multi-million dollar business migrations and zero critical production defects.

div.p: Software Quality Assurance Engineer with over 3 years of enterprise experience in Test Automation, Quality Assurance, API Testing, CI/CD, and Agile Software Delivery. Recognized with multiple awards including Impact Award (Top 5%), SPOT Awards, and STOM Awards for automation excellence, client delivery, and high-impact project contributions.

Actively driving AI-powered Quality Engineering initiatives by leveraging LLM-based applications and intelligent automation tools to reduce manual testing effort, enhance productivity, and improve testing efficiency. Additionally trained and mentored junior interns on LLM adoption and AI application development.

ul.class: text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm space-y-2 list-disc list-inside mb-6 font-light
ul.li: Designing and executing end-to-end test automation solutions using Playwright to ensure application stability, quality and release readiness.
Building and establishing QA processes from scratch, driving structured quality assurance practices across enterprise projects.
Leveraging Agentic AI, LLM-based applications and intelligent testing solutions to optimize testing workflows and reduce manual effort.
Mentoring interns and junior team members on QA automation best practices, Playwright, and AI-powered testing approaches.

div.div: Key Achievement: Contributed to a critical platform migration delivered 6 months ahead of schedule, enabling an estimated $11M business benefit while maintaining zero critical production defects.

ul.li: Automated regression test suites using Robot Framework, improving test coverage and execution efficiency.
Developed reusable Postman API test collections for back-end workflow validation and API quality assurance.
Executed functional, system, and regression testing within Agile Scrum environments.
